name: Voxel Erosion / Fracture
definition: A GPU-accelerated iterative erosion process that removes voxels from a voxelized model using configurable convolution masks, noise, and probability thresholds to simulate fracture or weathering.
summary: Voxel Erosion / Fracture is a GPU-accelerated iterative process that removes voxels to simulate fracture or weathering, distinguished by its probabilistic removal based on noise buffers rather than deterministic logical operations.
